name: UXR Tests - Logic Regression (Handler, Search, Send)
description: Reads the current staging Handler, Search and Send & Stamp definitions (read-only API calls) and runs their Code nodes with simulated inputs. No Slack, Customer.io or email. Run manually after any change to those workflows; fails if a check fails.

parameters.jsCode: const r=$input.first().json;let reportOnly=false;try{reportOnly=$('Called by Test Runner').first().json.returnReportOnly===true;}catch(e){}if(r.status!=='PASS'&&!reportOnly){const failed=(r.results||[]).filter(x=>x.status!=='PASS').map(x=>x.name).slice(0,8).join('; ');throw new Error('UXR logic regressions failed: '+failed+'. Open the output of Search and Send Rules Checks for the full report.');}return $input.all();
